page.notes: The Latin of the title is printed in mixed roman, italic and red type; the word "Spirituum" in the Dissertationes line is a doubtful reading, recorded here as printed: "Spirituum" [?]. The engraving shows two allegorical figures and a banner reading "VIVITUR INGENIO" (partly illegible in the scan). Library stamps (Biblioteca Nazionale, Roma, Vittorio Emanuele) and a blue seal are not transcribed. The date line is in the old reversed-C form: MDCLXXXV.
